text: Site "Blue Ridge Farm": Pittsylvania County, VA. 120 MW solar, no storage, COD 2030. Leased farmland in agricultural zoning, so we need a conditional use permit. The gen-tie is about 3 miles across 2 parcels. No wetlands mapped. A few farmhouses are nearby, and we have not done community outreach yet.

site.notes: Agricultural zoning; conditional use permit required.

result.summary: Local zoning approval (conditional or special use permit) plus a comprehensive-plan review are required. Localities can negotiate siting agreements. State DEQ Permit by Rule covers solar up to 150 MW.
